class.name: InputMapSettingsRows
class.brief_description: The content of a version 2 settings file of [InputMapSettingsServer].
class.description: The file form of [InputActions] in the settings files of [InputMapSettingsServer] before format version 3: one [InputMapSettingsRow] per action. The server only reads it, to load old files; it writes [InputMapSettingsActions] (CSV: [InputMapSettingsEventRows]). Games do not need this class.
